rootCauses.finding: A visible-paper segmentation can turn an occluder into apparent background and produce a false notch.
rootCauses.evidence: The independently constructed narrow-occluder fixture is incorrectly supported with a 30px notch error; the source teal-checker image shows the same failure pattern.
rootCauses.consequence: A low body probability must not always be treated as evidence of exposed background. Maintain occlusion/visibility uncertainty or fit an underlying silhouette with appropriate evidence.

rootCauses.finding: Notch plus lower-edge lines do not determine a general projective overlap. The affine proposal supplies an extra parallelogram assumption.
